title: Shinonome Ena — Regretful Pentimento〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today's assignment was tough... It's so hard to capture multiple themes in one sketch.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Right? Drawing each object is itself a challenge, but you also need to think carefully about the composition.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I think I'll try it again later with what I have at home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Futaba? Outside of reviewing class assignments, how else do you practice?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Me? Hmm, I do a few things...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Lately, I've been reattempting compositions and themes that didn't go well in the past.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: It's been fun to see how much I've improved, and I've even come up with better ways to structure each piece.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Things that didn't go well in the past...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I've given up on a lot of pieces halfway because I wasn't satisfied with them.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I attempted some difficult compositions and themes to try and prove him wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh yeah. Didn't I try to paint an undersea scene one time?
I was going to prove myself with this ethereal depiction of bubbles and sunlight.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I couldn't paint it how I imagined it... And his words kept rattling around my head...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (In the end, I got so frustrated I threw it in the trash...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry. It's nothing.
I was just thinking how I also have pieces I never finished.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Oh, I see... Things really don't go to plan sometimes, hey?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: But I really do recommend giving old pieces another shot! You'll notice things you hadn't before, plus you can appreciate how far you've come since then!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It sounds like it. Thanks for the advice, Futaba. I'm going to have a think what I could do.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: But I really do recommend giving old pieces another shot! You'll notice things you hadn't before, plus you can appreciate how far you've come since then!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder how that undersea painting would turn out if I did it now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, it's not just that one. There are so many other paintings and drawings I started but couldn't finish.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm, what were they...?
I kinda remember pieces like that undersea one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: All I can remember is throwing my entire sketchbook in the trash in a fit of anger.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For now, I just want to get my rough draft for N25 finished today. I can try to remember again when I have more time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I figured someone wanted me to come since my phone suddenly flashed like that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway. I need to get back and finish my draft... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Was this always here? It feels really out of place... I'll just pick it up and—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Where am I?!
I was in SEKAI just a second ago!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Woah, what's with all this crumpled paper? Did they tear up a whole sketchbook or something...? Oh, and these canvases have holes in them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There's one here that's fallen down.
Oh, and one there too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's too cluttered to move around, so I may as well pick some canvases off the floor.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, no.
Whose workshop is this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've got enough on my plate right now without tidying up someone else's art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, I'll check the paintings I just picked up. One of them could be signed or something—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This painting of the sea... It's familiar...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This is...my painting.
The underwater scene I was trying to paint.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This hole... I tore it out of frustration when I couldn't paint the scene how I imagined it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, so that crumpled paper was...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Urgh, really? You didn't need to shred it so thoroughly. Oh, there's more here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew...
Well, I put together any pieces that looked like they belonged together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And I was right...
These are all mine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I remember tearing up this sketch of a forest, but this one of a girl... I threw away the entire sketchbook, so how can she be in shreds too?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
More importantly, how are they all here?
And most importantly, what even is this place?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Like, did I fall asleep while I was working on my draft?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
No use mulling it over, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It hurts a little to see my own art in tatters like this.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Even if I tore up some of them myself, that's not the case for the girl...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I remember blurring the background to make her the focal point, and trying really hard to get her expression right.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I imagined her looking out toward a town in the distance with a sparkle in her eye, as if to say, “That's where I'm headed!”)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wanted to have that town faintly reflected in her eyes.)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to draw something... Anything!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if I lose my ability to draw, then I'd really...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why am I so bad at this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I really couldn't draw or paint anything back then...
Every time I worked on something, I was crying.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was crying when I drew this girl, too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I started to draw, but nothing came to me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The hopefulness I wanted to put in her eyes... That spark...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I'm sorry I couldn't draw you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Want me to draw you properly?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Her expression might not be exactly what I imagine.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know what this place is or why my art is here. But I don't care anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There are so many unfinished pieces. And so...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This time, I'm going to complete every last one.
